text: Penhallow Estates renewal: Iris Calloway wants to move from monthly to annual billing if we give 8% off. Is that reasonable?
reply:
Logged. Penhallow Estates renewal: Iris Calloway requests 8% discount for switching from monthly to annual billing.

An 8% discount is generally reasonable and competitive for B2B SaaS/services when securing an annual commitment, as it improves cash flow predictability and reduces churn risk. It aligns with standard industry incentives (typically 10–20% off monthly rates for annual prepay). I recommend approving it unless your margin constraints are tight, in which case you could counter with 5–6%.
